service.en: Entry permit at ports (land, sea, air)
service.ur: بندرگاہوں سے داخلے کا اجازت نامہ

about: Get an entry visa on arrival, such as a transit, seafarer, emergency or GCC resident visa.
note: Requirements read from the official ICP service page on the checked date. ICP fills the form in from the person's records after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: 96-hour transit visa at air and sea ports; 48-hour at sea ports; both need a valid passport and onward ticket
Seafarer single-entry visa is valid 7 days
Emergency visa for medical disembarking or long flight disruption is free
GCC residents need a residence of at least one year in an authorised category
fees: 96-hour transit: 50 AED application, 50 AED issue, 100 AED smart service
48-hour transit: 50 AED issue, 100 AED smart service
GCC resident: 100 AED application, 100 AED issue, 100 AED smart service
channels: ICP Smart Services website or ICP Smart App (sign in with UAE PASS)
